title: Master's Trial power partly restored, high tiers hit hardest
summary: One version after the big rescale, Master's Trial power moves back up across most of the ladder: tiers 1-5 and 13-50 rise while tiers 6-12 come down slightly, and the 350 NPC rows behind them shift to between 0.92x and 2.82x their previous stats. It is a genuine re-tune of that mode's difficulty curve rather than bookkeeping.
highlights: Tier 1 monster power rises from 21,688,000 to 36,956,000; tier 50 from 171,679,000 to 289,685,000.
Tiers 6 to 12 are the only ones reduced, for example tier 7 from 57,360,000 to 55,204,000.
The increases steepen up the ladder: tier 25 rises from 117,708,000 to 148,628,000.
monster_npc attack and defence: 301 rows increased and 49 decreased, 0.92x to 2.59x previous (ids 230011-230507).
monster_npc health: 301 rows increased and 49 decreased, 0.92x to 2.82x previous, across the same rows.
NPC changes are reported as aggregate counts and factors only, so no individual monster row is named.
